CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Blue Owl (NYSE: OWL) is a leading asset manager that is redefining alternatives. With $330 billion in assets under management as of September 30, 2026, we invest across three multi-strategy platforms: Credit, Real Assets and GP Strategic Capital. Anchored by a strong permanent capital base, we provide businesses with private capital solutions to drive long-term growth and offer institutional investors, individual investors, and insurance companies differentiated alternative investment opportunities that aim to deliver strong performance, risk-adjusted returns, and capital preservation. Together with approximately 1,430 experienced professionals globally, Blue Owl brings the vision and discipline to create the exceptional.
